verdict: Organic activity is slowing; paid channels need to be switched back on.
narrative: This period, all lead generation ran on organic sources alone — paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend and zero leads across the full 28 days. Your Google Business Profile delivered 88 total actions (18 calls, 29 direction requests, 41 website clicks), but that momentum has stalled sharply, with GBP activity down 45% in the last 7 days versus the 7 days before, and the final four days of the window showing no recorded actions at all. Instagram reach followed the same direction, falling 40% week over week. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to restore a reliable lead flow into your pipeline.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement has fully stalled over the last four days, and organic reach on Instagram is also declining — the account has no paid channel to absorb that drop.
